name: Priscilla
bio: Priscilla, wife of Aquila, had recently come to Corinth from Rome with her husband after Claudius ordered all Jews to leave the city; Paul, a fellow tentmaker, lodged and worked with them. When Paul later sailed for Syria, Priscilla and Aquila went with him as far as Ephesus, where they stayed; there they took in the eloquent preacher Apollos and taught him the way of God more fully, since he knew only the baptism of John (Acts 18:1-3, 18-19, 24-26).
